**Week ending Fri 11/06** · seeded Sun 11/01

**Seed list from Michael.** These are his names for the week. The board is everyone's, so add yours.

**The read:** The Fed held on 10/28, but two members voted to hike, and December hike odds are high. Chips got hit Friday on Intel's guidance. **Nothing below is a buy at Friday's close.** Every name waits for its trigger or its dip.

**Key dates:** NVDA earnings Tue 11/17 · NFLX/PYPL trigger deadline Fri 11/20 · AWS re:Invent 11/30 · FOMC 12/8-9

**How to use this thread**
👍 like it · 👎 pass · 👀 watching, react on each card below
Reply to a card with notes. Add a name: `$TICKER` + trigger + where it's wrong.

Sizes are in R. 1R = what you're willing to lose on one trade.
-# Watchlist ideas, not trade signals. Not financial advice.

## EQT · 6/10 · 1.0R
Natural gas. The real hedge on this board (beta -0.27 to the S&P).
**Trigger:** daily close > $55.50 · **Stop:** $52.75
**Targets:** $57.50 / $60.25
**How:** shares or Dec 18 $52.50 call
**Why:** reclaimed its 200-day, dealer support at $55, already reported 10/27 so no earnings this month.
**Watch:** Range Resources merger arb caps the upside.

## NVDA · 6/10 · 0.5R (+0.25R optional)
**Trigger:** daily close > $210 · **Stop:** $200
**Targets:** $218.40 / $243
**How:** Dec 18 $200 call. Close it or move the stop to breakeven before earnings Tue 11/17. Optional 0.25R: Dec 18 205/220 call spread to hold through the print.
**Why:** sitting on its 200-day with a big put wall at $200. Four straight beats.
**Watch:** IV rank ~60 and a ~13% earnings move priced. Calls are expensive.

## AMZN · ~6/10 (first pass) · 0.5R
**Trigger:** dip to $235-240 that holds · **Stop:** $228.75 (under Friday's low)
**Targets:** $254 / $265
**How:** shares or Dec/Jan $240 call
**Why:** gapped to $229 after earnings Friday and closed $240 on 2.8x volume. Buyers absorbed it. AWS grew 39%. re:Invent 11/30.
**Watch:** free cash flow is -$42B on $220B of capex, and dark pools were net sellers.

## NFLX · 5/10 · 0.5R total
**Trigger:** close > $64 (0.25R), add on a close > $66 (+0.25R) · **Stop:** $60.90
**Targets:** $72.70 / $81-83.60
**How:** Jan 15 $65 call, bought on trigger day only
**Drop it** if neither trigger fires by Fri 11/20.
**Why:** down 51% from the high, held flat Friday while the S&P fell 1.8%, and moves opposite NVDA (-0.33 correlation). IV is cheap.
**Watch:** every bounce for a year has made a lower high. Ad revenue guide was cut.

## USB · 5/10 · 0.75R
**Trigger:** daily close > $60 · **Stop:** $59.00
**Targets:** $62.50 / $65.40
**How:** Jan 15 $60 call (cheapest IV on the board)
**Why:** best quality bank of the bunch, net interest margin up three quarters running, above its 200-day.
**Watch:** a December hike cuts both ways for banks. $62.50 only gets the call to breakeven.

## TXN · 5/10 · 0.5R
**Trigger:** dip to $288-292 (stop $283) or a break > $310 (stop $300)
**Targets:** $311.50 / $330
**How:** Jan 15 300/320 call spread
**Why:** cleanest uptrend in chips, no November earnings.
**Watch:** 0.5 correlation to NVDA, so NVDA + TXN together stay at 1R max. Four directors sold about $6.4M.

## PYPL · 4/10 · 0.25R
**Trigger:** dip to $55.00-55.50 with a close in the upper half of the day · **Stop:** $53.40
**Target:** $60 (call wall, the realistic cap)
**How:** Jan 15 55/60 call spread (~$2.39, pays ~110% at $60)
**Drop it** if no dip by Fri 11/20. No breakout entry: $60 is too close to make it pay.
**Why:** about 10x earnings, ~12% buyback yield, a base of higher lows.
**Watch:** new CEO, branded checkout shrinking, and the August high was a buyout bid that died.
